inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL string-function reference projects the final three characters of a literal with RIGHT.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored ordered label report. Fixed ASCII labels exercise ordinary suffix extraction, zero length, overlong length, and NULL propagation without copying the source literal or surrounding example.

fixture_notes: Label 11 returns its three-character suffix, label 12 returns an empty suffix for length zero, label 13 returns the whole short label when the requested length is too large, and label 14 preserves NULL.
determinism_notes: Label IDs, text values, requested lengths, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipment_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_text VARCHAR(64) NULL, suffix_len INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT label_id, label_text, suffix_len, RIGHT(label_text, suffix_len) AS suffix_text FROM shipment_labels ORDER BY label_id
